messages.subject: Finding 'EasyParallel' (NewHybrids) Help
parts:
Hello all, I know this is a Google Group for the R package dartR, but I was hoping someone here might be able to point me in the direction of help for (or be able to directly help) the PopGen program 'EasyParallel', which essentially runs 'NewHybrids' in a GUI. I haven't been able to find any help online or from the creators yet, so I wanted to see if anyone here has used either of these before! 

https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0232110

Thanks,

Drew Hardy, M.S.
University of North Florida
Coastal and Marine Biology
